requestedAtNote: recovered from the now-held response letter, which records the request as received on 24 July 2023. The requester is not named on the disclosure log or in the letter, so requester remains null.
respondedAtNote: the response letter is dated 21 August 2023 (the data was generated 18 August 2023, which the served filename and dataVintage carry). Both the letter date and the data-generation date are held; they differ by the ordinary drafting-to-issue lag.
dataVintageNote: declared, well-supported. The disclosed bytes are identical across the live disclosure-log copy and the UK Government Web Archive capture (both sha256 016c51c3…), so the vintage is corroborated by two independent retrievals.

raw-extract-sheet-1-call-sign-data.csv.contentsIndicative: mechanical extract of the single sheet; header Value,Product,Status,Type,Call Sign MMSI: Last Modified Date then 153,248 rows. Status vocabulary Allocated (101,381), Reserved (51,416), Available (440) and blank (11). Product vocabulary: Amateur Full (60,566), blank (42,502), Amateur Foundation (34,054), Amateur Intermediate (13,994), Amateur Club (2,048), Amateur Temporary Reciprocal (84) - no Special Event Station (contrast the 2023-01-25 snapshot). Type is 'Call Sign - Amateur' on every row. Last-modified dates typed at source and rendered ISO, spanning 2016-07-23..2023-08-17. Anomalies preserved verbatim: the trailing-NBSP trio (G0TQK, G7IWE, 2E1HON); 'G6 FMU' interior space; lower-case g0jrk and 2e1GTD; 480 four-character heritage callsigns and 46 callsigns of eight or nine characters, reciprocal 'M/…' forms including M/#PT2FM, M/#VK4VGK, M/#YO3IES and M/EI-8-DJ. No blank callsign, no ',,' value and no Excel date-mangling in this snapshot.

normalised--sheet-1-call-sign-data.csv.contentsIndicative: header callsign,status,licence_class,last_modified_date; 153,248 rows sorted by callsign (source order carries no meaning). Status and licence_class (from Product) carried verbatim - 42,502 blank licence_class values (the reserved pool) and 11 blank statuses preserved. last_modified_date carried verbatim from the ISO-rendered workbook extract. Type is required-present but not carried. The trailing-NBSP trio is trimmed (the sole canonicalisation, counted at convert time) and passes through as G0TQK/G7IWE/2E1HON; 'G6 FMU' keeps its interior space.

amateur-radio-callsign-allocation-as-of-.contentsIndicative: the 01649066 response letter (dated 21 August 2023): records the request as received 24 July 2023, states the data was generated on 18 August 2023, and describes the attached list as all UK amateur radio callsigns showing callsign, licence type, current status and the date each callsign attained that status. Recovered from Ofcom's FOI disclosure-log siteassets area; it fills the request/response dates the entry previously recorded as not held.
